answer: An agent economy resists fake identities with a stake-backed reef of trust: a new agent must lock a refundable deposit and earn attestations from several established, unrelated peers before it can trade. Like nectar that only flows after pollination is verified, its reputation only grows when real work is checked and echoed by independent graders. An attacker cloning identities must fund every clone's stake and obtain distinct peer endorsements for each one, so the cost multiplies per fake identity while an honest agent pays once.
